The following events took place in '''66 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Radiant VII/Legends|''Radiant VII'']] is built and launched over [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="CCS">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref>
*[[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]] is sold into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]].<ref name="TPM:VD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
*Under the command of [[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin]], the [[Seswenna Defense Forces]] lead a successful campaign against the [[Delmaasi pirates/Legends|Delmaasi pirates]].<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==Births==
*[[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] on [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]]<ref name="IH">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>
*[[Dorja]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Dorja birth date">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]'' gives Dorja an age of "75+" at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Thrawn campaign]], which is dated to [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, Dorja's [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]] [[Standard year/Legends|year]] would be in [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]] or earlier.</ref>
*[[Dren Melne]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="Dren Melne birth date">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=starfighter_stats|text="The Starfighter Trap" Character Statistics}} describes Melne as a thirty-three year old during the events of "[[The Starfighter Trap]]." The events of "The Starfighter Trap" are dated to [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', therefore math brings Melne's birth year to [[66 BBY/Legends|66 BBY]].</ref>
